title: TEXEL - University of Groningen Neuromorphic Processor
summary: The TEXEL chip is an 180 nm mixed-signal spiking neural network processor developed by the University of Groningen and international collaborators. It features 180 AdExLIF neurons, approximately 10K plastic synapses, and asynchronous Address Event Representation (AER) interfaces. The platform validates on-chip learning via a CMOS implementation of the BiCaLL rule and supports integration with two- or three-terminal memristive devices through an agnostic Back-of-Electronics Layer interface. Characterized at 25.9 pJ per spike operation, it demonstrates vector-symbolic architecture capabilities for semantic encoding.
tldr: TEXEL is a validated research processor demonstrating on-chip learning and hybrid CMOS-memristor integration using BiCaLL plasticity rules.
useCases: Research platform for hybrid CMOS-memristor systems
